questions.question: What happens if the emergency air line loses pressure?

options.text: The Anti-Lock Braking System will activate.
The service air line will activate.

questions.explanation: The emergency air line controls the emergency brakes on a combination vehicle. If the emergency line loses air pressure, the emergency trailer brakes will activate.

questions.question: What is a bobtail tractor?

options.text: A tractor that travels faster than the speed limit

questions.explanation: A bobtail tractor is a tractor without a semi-trailer. Bobtail tractors are difficult to operate and require careful driving.

questions.question: How should you use the trailer hand valve?

options.text: Use it only for parking on a downgrade.

questions.explanation: Do not use the trailer hand valve for parking. Using it may release air pressure from the braking system and cause the brakes to fail. Instead, use the parking brake or wheel chocks.

questions.question: Why is watching the road ahead important?

options.text: It is more dangerous than only watching your mirrors.
It does not help you drive more safely.
It helps you avoid sudden lane changes.

questions.correctAnswerText: It helps you avoid sudden lane changes.
questions.explanation: Sudden lane changes are dangerous when driving a combination vehicle. By watching the road ahead, you can spot obstacles early and avoid the need to make sudden lane changes.

questions.question: Older trailers without spring brakes lose their air supply. What happens?

options.text: The trailer will have no brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The trailer will have no brakes.
questions.explanation: Older trailers do not have spring brakes. If the air supply leaks away, there are no working brakes and the wheels will turn freely.

questions.question: What does the emergency air line supply air to?
questions.explanation: The emergency air line (also called the supply line) supplies air to the trailer air tanks and controls the emergency brakes on combination vehicles.

questions.question: What should you do before starting a trip?

options.text: Leave the service line valve open.

questions.explanation: Before a trip, open the rear emergency line and service line shut-off valves and listen for escaping air to check that all air brakes work. Then close both shut-off valves before driving.

questions.question: Trailers built before what year are not required to have spring brakes?
questions.explanation: Trailers built before 1975 do not have spring brakes. When parking a trailer without spring brakes, use wheel chocks to prevent rolling.

questions.question: How should you apply brakes on a vehicle with Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS)?

options.text: In the same way as a vehicle without ABS.
As the vehicle is placed in neutral.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the same way as a vehicle without ABS.
questions.explanation: You should apply brakes on a vehicle with ABS the same way you would on a vehicle without ABS.

questions.question: When should you look into the back of the fifth wheel?

options.text: If your vehicle begins to skid.

questions.explanation: When inspecting a coupling, look into the back of the fifth wheel. Make sure the fifth wheel jaws are secured around the kingpin shank.

questions.question: Operating combination vehicles usually requires ____ operating single vehicles.

options.text: About the same level of skill as

questions.explanation: Combination vehicles are heavier and longer than single vehicles. They need more driving skill to operate safely.

questions.question: If you must cross traffic while driving a combination vehicle, you should:

options.text: Assume other drivers will make room for your vehicle.
Wait for a gap large enough for your vehicle to safely cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for a gap large enough for your vehicle to safely cross.
questions.explanation: Combination vehicles need more space than other vehicles. Always wait for a large enough gap in traffic before entering or crossing.

questions.question: Pushing in the trailer air supply control will:
questions.explanation: Push in the trailer air supply control to send air to the trailer. Pull it out to turn off the air supply and activate the emergency brakes.

questions.question: The service air line is often controlled by the foot brake and is attached to the ____ valves.
questions.explanation: The service air line is controlled by the foot brake or trailer hand brake. It connects to relay valves, which apply the trailer brakes quickly.

questions.question: What does an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) do?

options.text: It allows a vehicle's wheels to lock up.
It prevents a vehicle's wheels from locking up.
It makes turning a vehicle easier.

questions.correctAnswerText: It prevents a vehicle's wheels from locking up.
questions.explanation: An Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) stops your wheels from locking when you brake hard. It reduces braking pressure to keep your wheels rolling.

questions.question: When coupling, after you've connected the air lines to the trailer, you should:
questions.explanation: After connecting the air lines to the trailer, supply air to it. Following proper coupling steps is important for safe operation.

questions.question: More than half of all accident-related truck driver deaths are caused by:
questions.explanation: Rollovers cause more than half of all truck driver deaths from accidents. To prevent rollovers, keep cargo low and centered. Take turns slowly.

questions.question: Combination vehicles need extra space on the road because they:

options.text: Drive more slowly than other commercial motor vehicles.
Are heavier than other commercial motor vehicles.
Need more space to turn and stop than other commercial motor vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Need more space to turn and stop than other commercial motor vehicles.
questions.explanation: Combination vehicles are longer and need more space to turn and stop than other commercial vehicles. Always manage space carefully when operating one.

questions.question: If you use the trailer hand brake while your trailer is skidding, it will:
questions.explanation: If your trailer is skidding, release the brakes to help tires regain grip. Using the trailer hand brake during a skid will make it worse.

questions.question: During a trip, the ____ should be open.
questions.explanation: Keep all shut-off valves open during a trip, except the last ones on the rear trailer. This ensures air reaches all brakes and does not escape from the back.
